behaviors.trigger: Run the advisor Python maintenance test suite
inputs: Real local Python children, pipes and queues with controlled failure injection
behaviors.completion: Assertions verify raw evidence retention, truthful errors, bounded cleanup and denial of advice after failure.
outputs: unittest results and coverage in a fresh evidence directory
effects: Temporary synthetic processes and files; owned resources cleaned in finally
behaviors.failure: Retain failing assertions; do not weaken or replace actual cleanup behavior.
behaviors.recovery: Investigate retained results and fix production only when a test establishes a defect.

resources.purpose: Exercise cleanup and failure boundaries without running Claude

helper_contract.inputs: Synthetic process and OS fault fixtures
helper_contract.outputs: Executed assertions and unittest exit status
helper_contract.effects: Local child processes and temporary pipes only
helper_contract.errors: Nonzero test exit on failed assertions or fixture errors
helper_contract.reuse_reason: Regression coverage for rare cleanup paths

adverse_conditions.condition: Interrupted waits, queues or closes; pipe read failures; stale process races
adverse_conditions.expected_observation: Real resources cleaned where possible; uncertainty and failures retained; no valid advice
